text: {"overall_winner":"A","qualities":[{"evidence":"clear claim that driverless cars are \"good\" and \"the good outweighs the bad\"","quality":"thesis clarity","description":"The essay states a definite position early and makes its overall stance easy to follow."},{"evidence":"two developed body paragraphs with topic sentences","quality":"organizational structure","description":"The essay uses a recognizable introduction, body, and conclusion format that gives the argument shape."},{"evidence":"\"help to add knowledge and protection\" and \"beneficial to the growth of the economy\"","quality":"idea development","description":"The essay expands its argument into multiple supporting points rather than repeating one simple claim."},{"evidence":"sensor/braking quotation with explanation of preventing crashes","quality":"textual support use","description":"The essay uses article details and briefly explains how they support the writer's position."},{"evidence":"ending that revisits benefits and predicts the world will be \"a much better place\"","quality":"conclusion","description":"The essay closes by restating the position and summarizing the main reasons in a final wrap-up."}]}
